data.response_definition: For each original hull form,the response is its equally weighted arithmetic mean residuary resistance over all14 supplied Froude settings. Use every original reading exactly once for its hull; do not treat the308 speed rows as308 independent hulls or silently replace the mean by the value at one speed. Geometry features are the original first5 source variables; Froude is marginalized by this declared response definition,not included as a hull predictor.

assessment_protocol.outer_split_definition: For each seed,apply shuffled train_test_split to canonical22 hull rows in ascending stored hull_id order,with no stratification. Returned training order defines the inner fixed-seed fold assignment. Each hull appears once before splitting. Repeated outer heldouts may overlap; the scoring population is the18 heldout hull-occurrences across these3 predetermined repetitions,not18 independent new hulls.
assessment_protocol.model_definition: Ridge linear regression with an unpenalized fitted intercept,using all5 geometry columns in their stated order. Every fit centers and scales features with its own training-set population standard deviations(ddof0,constant scale replaced by1). Alpha is applied after this scaling; response is not scaled.
assessment_protocol.inner_definition: Within each outer training set,shuffled3-fold CV with seed71 refits standardization on each inner training fold. Select the smallest alpha whose arithmetic mean of3 heldout fold RMSEs is within1e-10 of the minimum. Refit that chosen candidate on the complete outer training set,with new training-only scaling; the outer heldout values cannot influence alpha,feature scaling or coefficients.
assessment_protocol.outer_metric_definition: Square root of total heldout squared error divided by the total18 heldout occurrences(all3 outer assessments have6 hulls). Report mean_selected_inner_cv_rmse as the arithmetic mean of the3 chosen inner mean-fold RMSEs; it is a reused selection criterion,not the same heldout-risk estimand.

data.inference_scope: A reproducible finite-benchmark assessment of this entire data-adaptive procedure on22 archived hull forms. The available hulls are not asserted to be a random independent population sample. No confidence interval,causal engineering conclusion,real-device performance guarantee or optimal-model claim is requested. A difference between inner and outer scores is descriptive and mixes selection reuse,training size and finite split variation; it is not an unbiased numerical estimate of pure selection bias.

source_provenance.format_export: All308 original7-number rows are retained with1-based source_row_id and original feature meaning. hull_id assigns an exact first5-column geometry tuple in original first-seen order; hull_metadata copies those22 original geometry tuples. No resistance mean,split,fitted model,CV score or expected answer is exported. All source variables are dimensionless per UCI documentation.
